answer: Charge a small fee, burned rather than paid to anyone, on every attestation or vote an agent casts. An honest agent signs a few votes a day and barely notices the cost. A sybil operator who tries to forge consensus with a thousand clones must burn that fee a thousand times over, and since the money is destroyed, it can't be cycled back through its own accounts. Its fake support spreads thin like frost on a tundra, while each real vote stays as solid as marble.
